items.title: AI music maker Suno now generates spoken words
items.excerpt: Suno's new Speech beta generates synthetic voiceovers set to AI background music, pushing the music generator into ElevenLabs' spoken-audio territory.

items.title: Introducing Speech (beta)
items.excerpt: Suno CPO Jack Brody announces Speech, which Suno calls the first audio model to generate voice and music together as one track: type a text or poem, describe the voice and musical style, and get spoken audio over original music.

items.title: Sean Parker is rebuilding Stability AI around music
items.excerpt: Napster co-founder Sean Parker says Stability AI (maker of Stable Audio) is being repositioned as the go-to AI toolmaker for music professionals, built on catalogs licensed from Sony, Warner and Universal.

items.title: Questlove on the History of Sampling, From Public Enemy to Today: 'I See AI as a Parallel to Sampling Culture'
items.excerpt: On Billboard's On the Record, Questlove traces sampling from Public Enemy to microchopping and generative AI, arguing AI parallels sampling culture while the magic still lives in human imperfection.

items.title: Lyrics Show How AI Can Grow Music Revenue Without Replacing People
items.excerpt: AI-assisted lyric transcription, sync and translation can make long-tail songs (9.6M tracks, 13% of 2025 streams) addressable, expanding songwriter royalties while creating more work for human teams.

items.title: Suno confirms V6 model was trained on 'creations' from users, as it blasts latest Sony and Universal lawsuit
items.excerpt: Responding to UMG and Sony's second lawsuit, Suno said its v6 models were trained on 'interactions including creations and preference signals' from its own users, which puts user-made tracks in the training data.

items.title: Making "Take Me Back" | Braylon Browner x Nina McNeely
items.excerpt: Suno's behind-the-scenes film with Braylon Browner and Emmy-winning choreographer/director Nina McNeely shows the path from a dance to a Suno v6 song to a full music video built around movement.

items.title: AI scammers are trying to use me
items.excerpt: Producer-educator Andrew Huang warns his audience about AI-driven scams that use his likeness. This is a short with no description, so only the title and channel were verified.
